title: Glucose-insulin minimal model (Bergman)
paper: Bergman, Phillips & Cobelli, J Clin Invest 1981; Bergman et al., Am J Physiol 1979
claim: With positive rate constants the two-compartment glucose/remote-insulin system has a unique asymptotically stable steady state.

variants.label: p1, p2 > 0 - decay in both compartments
p2 unconstrained - remote insulin decay can reverse
d2 = 0 - the X compartment loses its decay term entirely

notes: State is x = [G, X]: plasma glucose and remote insulin action. Shows that a component-wise system is expressible without extending the spec language - slicing (x[:, 0:1]) and cat(..., dim=1) work in the residual sandbox, so the two equations need not share a form. Rate constants are learned; Gb is fixed.
